Plan I's legend names seven hatchings in Reisner's hand: crude brick casing in situ, rubble, black granite casing in situ, emplacements of red granite casing and pillars, Turah limestone (Shepseskaf), core-walls of local limestone, and walls of Dyn VI(?) of local limestone.
